s: The rump state of former Czechoslovakia after the creation of the Slovak State, the annexation of Sudetenland by Nazi Germany, Carpathian Ruthenia by Hungary, and Trans-Olza by Poland.
resource scarcity, scarcity of resources (a situation where the demand for a resource exceeds its available supply)
Die zunehmende Ressourcenknappheit bei seltenen Erden verteuert die Produktion von Smartphones.
The increasing resource scarcity of rare earths makes the production of smartphones more expensive.
resource security (the reliable and sustainable access to raw materials, energy, and other essential inputs required for an economy)
Die nationale Strategie zur Ressourcensicherheit sieht eine verstärkte Nutzung von Recyclingmaterialien vor.
The national strategy for resource security envisages an increased use of recycled materials.
In Zeiten geopolitischer Spannungen wird die Ressourcensicherheit zu einer zentralen Aufgabe der Wirtschaftspolitik.

resource management (the efficient and effective development of an organization's or society's resources when they are needed; can include financial, human, natural, or technological resources)

Sustainable resource management is crucial to achieving the industry's long-term climate goals.
Durch optimiertes Ressourcenmanagement konnten die Betriebskosten um zehn Prozent gesenkt werden.
Through optimized resource management, operating costs were reduced by ten percent.
